response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_avg_feerate FROM pair_averages), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, pa.avg_feerate - om.mean_avg_feerate as excess FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE pa.avg_feerate > om.mean_avg_feerate), ranked_pairs AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) as rank_within_scope FROM filtered_pairs) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_within_scope FROM ranked_pairs WHERE rank_within_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_within_scope
